# `appt`

Helper: `appt({ day, month, title, lines, none })`  
Kit (`src/ui`): web-only (kit gap) · status: kit gap (web-only)  
App (KMP `core:ui`): `PemaTile` (core:ui)

## Anatomy

Date tile (58 x 60, brand-50: day 20/700 over month in uppercase), bold title, grey lines.

## Variants

- Dated
- `none: true`: calendar icon and "Chọn lịch"

## States

- Static: it has no hover, focus or disabled state of its own

## Tokens

brand-50, brand-100, brand-700, ink, ink-soft, radius-tile

## Do

- Put it in a card ("Lịch hẹn tiếp theo")

## Don't

- Do not use it for a booking on a board (board)

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Web-only body. Tile 58 x 60.

## Mobile (390)

Same as 1440; the frame is narrower, nothing is hidden.

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

Appointment card body: date tile ("20" / "THÁNG 09"), bold title, grey lines. `none: true` = no valid date, calendar icon and "Chọn lịch" in the tile. Put it in a `card` (home "Lịch hẹn tiếp theo", appointments "Sắp tới")
